id: \rI've been all over the place. The world is never ending.
en: \rI've been all over the place. The world is never ending.
it: \rSono stata ovunque. Il mondo non finisce mai.

id: \bThe students learn so much from the school we have here.
en: \bThe students learn so much from the school we have here.
it: \bGli studenti imparano tantissimo nella scuola che abbiamo qui.

Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Ferrugipoli: \nPetra
La studentessa modello che ama le rocce!
\bStai cercando qualcuno?

id: \bThis town is the home of science. Not even Kanto can beat us.
en: \bThis town is the home of science. Not even Kanto can beat us.
it: \bQuesta città è la patria della scienza. Nemmeno Kanto può batterci.

id: \rMr Briney has such a cute Wingull, Peeko.
en: \rMr Briney has such a cute Wingull, Peeko.
it: \rIl sig. Marino ha un Wingull adorabile, Peeko.
\bTi serve qualcosa?

id: \bI should get going soon. My family is waiting.
en: \bI should get going soon. My family is waiting.
it: \bDovrei andare tra poco. La mia famiglia mi aspetta.

id: \bWe experiment and create many things at the Devon Corporation.
en: \bWe experiment and create many things at the Devon Corporation.
it: \bAlla Devon SpA facciamo esperimenti e creiamo molte cose.

id: Devon Corporation\nFor all your living needs, we make it all.
en: Devon Corporation\nFor all your living needs, we make it all.
it: Devon SpA\nPer ogni esigenza della tua vita, produciamo di tutto.

id: \bRoxanne can be really tough. I've perfected a move to beat her though.
en: \bRoxanne can be really tough. I've perfected a move to beat her though.
it: \bPetra sa essere davvero tosta. Però ho perfezionato una mossa per batterla.

id: \bIt's called Iron Tail. Wanna learn it?
en: \bIt's called Iron Tail. Wanna learn it?
it: \bSi chiama Codacciaio. Vuoi impararla?
\bTorna quando sei pronto.
\rBanette...

id: It seems like the Banette is looking for its Trainer. Ask around and see if you can find them.
en: It seems like the Banette is looking for its Trainer. Ask around and see if you can find them.
it: Sembra che Banette stia cercando il suo Allenatore. Chiedi in giro e vedi se riesci a trovarlo.

id: \rRoxanne is the Gym Leader of this city.
en: \rRoxanne is the Gym Leader of this city.
it: \rPetra è la Capopalestra di questa città.
\rUsa Pokémon di tipo Roccia.

id: \bRoxanne was in a hurry. I think she said she was going to the school.
en: \bRoxanne was in a hurry. I think she said she was going to the school.
it: \bPetra andava di fretta. Mi pare abbia detto che andava a scuola.

id: Rustboro City\nThe city probing the integration of nature and science.
en: Rustboro City\nThe city probing the integration of nature and science.
it: Ferrugipoli\nLa città che esplora l'unione tra natura e scienza.
